NVIDIA GR207

NVIDIA's GR207 GPU uses the Rubin 2.0 architecture and is made using a 3 nm production process at TSMC. GR207 supports DirectX 12 Ultimate (Feature Level 12_2). It also supports OpenGL 4.6 and Vulkan 1.4. For GPU compute applications, OpenCL version 3.0 and CUDA 12.0 can be used. Additionally, the DirectX 12 Ultimate capability guarantees support for hardware-raytracing, variable-rate shading and more, in upcoming video games.
Further reading: Rubin Architecture Whitepaper
